title: ux(cli): diff-scoped badge group still labeled for README status after the chooser reserves README for repo ledger
body:
Follow-up residual from #5211 direction B (#5743), verified live on main 8f29e0cfe.

Reproduction: build main, run `ripr check --help` on any repo. The chooser says:

```
README badge -> repo-badge-shields (repo ledger); PR/CI status
badge -> badge-shields (diff)
```

but the retained format group directly below still reads:

```
Badge (diff-scoped, for README status):
  badge-json, badge-shields, badge-plus-json, badge-plus-shields
```

A newcomer following the chooser to repo-badge-shields for README, then reading a diff-scoped group labeled for README status, can still hesitate about which badge a README should consume. Per docs/BADGE_ADOPTION.md rule 1, README consumes the repo ledger (repo-badge-*); the diff-scoped badge-* family serves PR/CI status.

Scope: rename the diff-scoped group label (and any identical string in docs/help tests) so it no longer claims README status; e.g. Badge (diff-scoped, for PR/CI status). No format, analysis, or output-content change.

Acceptance:
- [ ] `ripr check --help` names exactly one README badge path (repo ledger) with no competing for-README label on the diff-scoped group.
- [ ] Existing chooser pin (check_help_chooses_one_format_per_task) extended or accompanied by a negative needle so the old label cannot return silently.
- [ ] docs/CONFIGURATION.md + docs/BADGE_ADOPTION.md badge contracts still agree with the rendered labels.
